verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Navan exposing its own MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) can query Navan data — this is Navan acting as an MCP server/provider, not as a client that plugs in outside MCP servers to use their tools. There is no evidence that Navan or its AI assistant (Ava) can connect to and consume third-party MCP servers itself.
